data.standardized_narrative: At the 2017 year end Syndicate 1969 recorded a small prior-year adverse development: a deterioration of $5.582m (approximately 2.4% of opening gross claims outstanding) in prior year claims reserves. The movement is described as a deterioration in claims reserves established at the prior year and is attributable primarily to adverse development in property-related business following natural catastrophe and weather-related events, which materially affected the Property (Direct & Facultative) account.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of $225,755,000 (2016: $142,768,000) is a deterioration of $5,582,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year (2016: release $3,362,000).
These events have contributed to a significant loss for the syndicate.
The result was also impacted by the habitational sub-class of business within the Property Direct and Facultative ("Property D&F") account.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is the explicitly stated deterioration of $5,582,000 quoted in the notes as 'deterioration' within net claims incurred. The report does not explicitly state the GROSS (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement separately; the cited sentence appears to refer to net claims incurred context and may be net of reinsurance. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was found giving a gross-only prior year movement. Therefore the prior year development value is taken from the reported deterioration sentence (interpreted as a quantified prior-year reserve movement) and flagged as possibly net. Gross opening reserves are taken from the balance sheet (claims outstanding).
